Use this prompt for your AI coding assistant: --- Implement a Persistent Video Banner Across the Entire Website I have a 4-minute background video that should be used as the hero/banner background across my Next.js/React website. Requirements 1. Continuous Playback Across Route Changes The video must not restart when navigating between pages. Keep the same video instance alive. Navigation between routes should preserve the video's playback position. The user should experience uninterrupted playback. 2. Global Layout Move the video into the highest shared layout (App Router app/layout.tsx or Pages Router _app.tsx) so it is mounted only once. The video component should persist while only the page content changes. 3. Hero Banner Display the video as the hero/banner background. Requirements: Cover the entire hero section object-fit: cover Responsive on all screen sizes Smooth fade-in No black flashes No layout shift 4. Video Settings The video should: autoplay muted loop playsInline preload="auto" It should never require user interaction. 5. Performance Optimization Optimize the implementation by: Loading the video only once Preventing duplicate network requests Avoiding unnecessary React re-renders Using memoization where appropriate Keeping memory usage low Ensuring smooth playback 6. Route Transitions When navigating: Home → About About → Services Services → Therapies Contact → Home the video must continue playing seamlessly from its current timestamp. There should be: no restart no flicker no pause no reloading 7. Overlay Content The banner should support page-specific overlay content such as: headings subheadings buttons breadcrumbs without affecting video playback. 8. Responsive Design Ensure the banner works on: Mobile Tablet Desktop Ultra-wide screens The video should always fill the container correctly. 9. Browser Compatibility Verify compatibility with: Chrome Edge Firefox Safari Mobile Safari Android Chrome 10. Fallback If autoplay is blocked or the video cannot load: display a high-quality poster image gracefully recover when the video becomes available 11. File Placement Move the video to the appropriate static assets directory (e.g., public/videos/) and reference it correctly. 12. Code Quality Create a reusable PersistentVideoBanner component. Use clean, modular code. Avoid duplication. Follow React and Next.js best practices. Add comments explaining key implementation decisions. 13. Final Verification Confirm that: The video loads only once. The video never restarts during page navigation. The current playback time is preserved across routes. There are no memory leaks. There are no hydration issues. There are no console errors. The website remains performant and responsive. The implementation is production-ready. --- Note: If your banner content is different on each page, the best architecture is to keep the video component persistent in the root layout and render only the overlay text/buttons as page-specific children. This gives the seamless playback effect you're looking for.
